subject: [PATCH 6/8] selftests/nfsd: factor the netlink plumbing into a shared header

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch moves the generic-netlink plumbing code from nfsd_netlink_listener.c to a shared header file nfsd_netlink.h, making it reusable by other NFS selftests without adding extra dependencies. The code is refactored as static inline functions to ensure each test binary gets its own copy and there's nothing extra to link.
